category.reason: The task requires comparing the cart subtotal with the budget and, if necessary, comparing item prices to choose the appropriate action.

instruction.en: I have a budget of $38. Check the total price of the items in the cart. If it does not exceed the budget, proceed to checkout; otherwise, remove one of the least expensive items.
instruction.zh: 我有 $38 的预算，检查购物车中物品的总价，如果没有超出预算就进行结账，否则就删除一个最便宜的商品。
